note: bicyclo[2.2.2]octane, no stereo/E-Z at all. chematic gives a DIFFERENT canonical string for two independently-written SMILES of the same molecule -- a genuine permutation-invariance failure. Pre-existing, already documented as a non-panicking known gap in crates/chematic-smiles/tests/canonical_robustness.rs (`bridged_bicyclic_canonical_gap_documentation`); independently reconfirmed still present at commit 659baca. Root cause: bridged-ring traversal/ring-closure-digit assignment is sensitive to which ring atom the canonical DFS happens to reach first among tied candidates, not to any stereo or aromaticity mechanism.

Trisubstituted alkene carbon (=C(\C)C(=O)Ar) has TWO candidate substituent bonds that could carry the redundant E/Z direction marker; chematic's canonical writer (crates/chematic-smiles/src/canonical.rs, normalize_ez ~L443-470) only normalizes the FLIP POLARITY of whichever bond the PARSED INPUT happened to mark -- it never re-derives, from canonical rank, WHICH of the two substituent bonds should carry the mark. Two RDKit-valid re-spellings of the identical molecule mark different substituents, so chematic's own output differs even though the encoded Z value never changes (RDKit-confirmed: both outputs re-canonicalize identically and BondStereo is STEREOZ in both). Corpus-wide: 281/5000 (5.62%) ChEMBL molecules hit this, i.e. 54% of all E/Z-bearing molecules in the corpus -- 100% of the 281 have a >=trisubstituted stereo double bond (0 counterexamples), and 0/281 show an actual E/Z VALUE flip.

Same normalize_ez mechanism as perm-inv-02, on a trisubstituted exocyclic imine (C=N) adjacent to a ring-closure digit instead of a plain chain alkene -- confirms the bug is not specific to C=C or to chain position. Contains a real tetrahedral stereocenter ([C@H]) that survives unaffected in both outputs (CIP not part of this residual).

Acyclic, no fragments, no automorphism ties -- chematic and RDKit simply pick different valid start-atom/branch choices. Classified 'unclassified' by the heuristic cosmetic-bucket function (no ring/fragment/symmetry-tie signal fires) yet Check 4 (RDKit structural re-comparison) confirms 0 semantic difference. Included as a fixture because this is the residual class the heuristic bucketer is weakest at explaining -- pinned so a future, better heuristic can be checked against a known example.
